package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	var v any = 7
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case int:
		fmt.Println("an int, doubled:", x*2)
	case string:
		fmt.Println("a string of length", len(x))
	default:
		fmt.Printf("something else: %T\n", x)
	}
	fmt.Println("done")
}
